content: Famciclovir is a medication used to treat infections caused by specific viruses, including shingles (herpes zoster) and outbreaks of herpes simplex, such as cold sores, genital herpes, and sores around the anus. While it is not a cure for these infections, it helps reduce the severity and duration of outbreaks, promotes faster healing of sores, prevents the formation of new sores, and alleviates associated pain and itching. It may also reduce the duration of pain that persists after the sores heal. This medication works best when taken at the first sign of an outbreak, as directed by your doctor. To maintain its effectiveness, it is important to take it at evenly spaced intervals and complete the full prescribed course, even if symptoms improve. Common side effects include headache, nausea, and diarrhea. Serious allergic reactions are rare but possible. If you experience symptoms such as difficulty breathing or severe dizziness, seek immediate medical attention. This is not a comprehensive list of side effects; consult your doctor for further guidance. Before taking famciclovir, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, penciclovir, or any other substances. This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Famciclovir may occasionally cause dizziness or drowsiness, which can be exacerbated by alcohol or marijuana. Limit alcohol consumption while taking this medication. Famciclovir does not prevent the spread of genital herpes. To reduce the risk of transmission, avoid sexual contact during an outbreak or when symptoms are present. Even without symptoms, the virus can still be transmitted. Always use effective barrier methods, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during sexual activity. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, as its effects on an unborn baby are not fully known. It is also unclear whether famciclovir passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter how this medication works or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all medications and supplements you use and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In case of an overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Properly discard expired or unused medication as instructed by your pharmacist. Do not flush it down the toilet or pour it into a drain unless directed to do so. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information tailored to your specific health needs.
